Bhelasaṃhitā
med. by Bhela, disciple of Ātreya Punarvasu.
q. in Toḍarānanda, Weber 941; q. by Tīsaṭa in Cikitsākalikā, Weber 947; by Jagannātha in Yogasaṅgraha, Weber 958; by Vāgbhaṭa in his Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya,

; by Vācaka Dīpacandra in his Laṅghanapathyanirṇaya, BORI. D. XVI. i. 235.
See Āyurved kā Bṛhat Itihās, p.. 107, 177-80; also Broomfield, SBE. Ath. V. Intro. p.. xx, xxi.
For a study, see Tsutomu Yama7shita, Towards a Critical Ed.. of the Bhelasaṃhitā, Journal of the European Ayurvedic Society,

(corrected leaves of the text).
